word: It was sort of like Google in paperback form, 35 years before Google came along.
meaning: 它有點像是紙本形式的谷歌，早在谷歌出現三十五年前就已經存在了。
example: The Whole Earth Catalog served as a vast information resource, much like Google, but in print form.
hint:
中文解釋：用現代人熟悉的「Google」作比喻，讓聽眾立刻理解《全球概覽》的本質。
1) sort of like (phr.): 有點像；syn: similar to; ant: completely different from
2) paperback form (phr.): 平裝書形式；syn: printed version; ant: digital form
pronunciation: Comparison: SORT of like GOOG-le | in PA-per-back FORM | THIR-ty-FIVE YEARS be-fore GOOG-le came a-LONG.

word: It was idealistic, overflowing with neat tools and great notions.
meaning: 它充滿理想色彩，滿溢著實用的工具和偉大的構想。
example: The publication was full of optimism, practical ideas, and inspiring concepts.
hint:
中文解釋：描述《全球概覽》的精神內涵——理想主義加上實用性，是那個世代的精神象徵。
1) idealistic (adj.): 充滿理想的；syn: visionary; ant: cynical
2) notions (n.): 構想、想法；syn: ideas; ant: facts
pronunciation: Admiring: i-DE-al-IS-tic | o-VER-flow-ing with NEAT TOOLS | and GREAT NO-tions.

word: Stewart and his team put out several issues of The Whole Earth Catalog.
meaning: 斯圖爾特和他的團隊出版了好幾期的《全球概覽》。
example: Over the years, Stewart Brand and his team published multiple editions of the catalog.
hint:
中文解釋：簡述《全球概覽》的出版歷史，為後面「最終一期」做鋪墊。
1) put out (phr.): 出版、發行；syn: published; ant: stopped
2) several issues (n.): 好幾期；syn: multiple editions; ant: just one issue
pronunciation: Matter-of-fact: STEW-art and his TEAM | put OUT sev-eral IS-sues | of the WHOLE EARTH CAT-a-log.

word: And then, when it had run its course, they put out a final issue.
meaning: 然後，當它的使命完成之後，他們出版了最後一期。
example: When the catalog had fulfilled its purpose, they released one last edition.
hint:
中文解釋：「run its course」指完成使命、走到終點，帶著一種自然結束的圓滿感。
1) run its course (phr.): 走完它的歷程；syn: completed its purpose; ant: was ongoing
2) final issue (n.): 最後一期；syn: last edition; ant: first issue
pronunciation: Concluding: when it had RUN its COURSE | they put OUT a FI-nal IS-sue.

word: It was the mid-1970s, and I was your age.
meaning: 那是七○年代中期，我和你們現在一樣的年紀。
example: When the final issue came out in the mid-1970s, he was about the same age as the graduating students.
hint:
中文解釋：拉近與聽眾的距離——「I was your age」讓畢業生感受到共鳴，那份話是說給他自己年輕時的心。
1) mid-1970s (n.): 七○年代中期；syn: around 1975; ant: (n/a)
2) your age (phr.): 你們的年紀；syn: same as you; ant: much older
pronunciation: Personal: it was the mid-SEV-en-ties | and I was YOUR age.

word: On the back cover of their final issue was a photograph of an early-morning country road—the kind you might find yourself hitchhiking on if you were so adventurous.
meaning: 在最後一期的封底，是一張清晨鄉間小路的照片——那種你要是夠冒險，可能會搭便車走的路。
example: The back cover showed a quiet country road in early morning light, evoking a sense of adventure.
hint:
中文解釋：極具畫面感的細節描述——一條清晨的鄉村公路，象徵著開放的未來與冒險精神。
1) back cover (n.): 封底；syn: rear cover; ant: front cover
2) hitchhiking (v.): 搭便車；syn: thumbing a ride; ant: driving oneself
pronunciation: Visual: BACK COV-er | an EAR-ly-MOR-ning COUN-try ROAD | the kind you might HITCH-hike on.

word: Beneath it were the words 'Stay hungry. Stay foolish.'
meaning: 在那張照片下方，寫著這幾個字：「求知若飢，虛心若愚。」
example: Below the photograph, the farewell message read: 'Stay hungry. Stay foolish.'
hint:
中文解釋：《全球概覽》最後一期封底最著名的四個字——成為 Jobs 演講最重要的引用。
1) beneath (prep.): 在…下方；syn: below; ant: above
2) Stay hungry. Stay foolish. (phr.): 求知若飢，虛心若愚（永遠保持飢渴與謙遜）；syn: keep seeking, stay humble; ant: be satisfied, be arrogant
pronunciation: Reverent: BE-neath it | were the WORDS | STAY HUN-gry. STAY FOOL-ish. (pause between each)

word: It was their farewell message as they signed off.
meaning: 那是他們在告別之際留下的訊息。
example: Those words were the final message the publication gave to its readers before closing.
hint:
中文解釋：「signed off」是廣播術語，意指「結束廣播、道別」——為《全球概覽》的謝幕增添了詩意。
1) farewell message (n.): 告別訊息；syn: parting words; ant: greeting
2) signed off (phr.): 結束、道別（正式退出）；syn: said goodbye; ant: signed on
pronunciation: Closing: it was their FARE-well MES-sage | as they SIGNED OFF.
